author: N.G Martin, Hugo

steps.title: Homogenize liver tissue
steps.instruction: Homogenize liver tissue in PBS on ice using a mortar and pestle.

steps.title: Centrifuge sample
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the homogenate at 300 rpm for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend cells in lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 1 mL ATAC lysis buffer from the ATAC‑Seq kit (Active Motif, catalog 105310).

steps.title: Count nuclei and aliquot
steps.instruction: Count nuclei and aliquot 5 × 10⁴ nuclei per ATAC‑Seq reaction.

steps.title: Tagmentation reaction
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL Tagmentation Master Mix to each reaction and incubate at 37 °C for 30 minutes in a Thermoshaker (Life Technologies).

steps.title: Add purification buffers
steps.instruction: Transfer reactions to new tubes, then add 250 µL DNA Purification Binding Buffer and 5 µL 3 M sodium acetate to each; no pH adjustment is required.

steps.title: Purify DNA with columns
steps.instruction: Purify DNA using the DNA purification columns supplied with the ATAC‑Seq kit.

steps.title: Quantify DNA with Qubit
steps.instruction: Quantify the purified DNA using a Qubit fluorometer (Thermo Scientific).

steps.title: PCR amplify libraries
steps.instruction: Prepare sequencing libraries by PCR amplification using the NEBNext Ultra library preparation kit, following the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: DNA clean‑up with SPRI beads
steps.instruction: Clean up the amplified DNA using 1.2 × the sample volume of SPRI beads provided in the kit.

steps.title: Assess libraries with BioAnalyzer
steps.instruction: Assess library quality and quantity with a BioAnalyzer (Agilent).

steps.title: Sequence libraries on NovaSeq
steps.instruction: Sequence the libraries on an Illumina NovaSeq instrument, targeting an average depth of 50 million paired‑end 150 bp reads per library.
